capabilities: Add child, sibling, and follow-up nodes with orthogonal or native arrow links
Duplicate nodes and groups while preserving internal links
Copy and paste group data as JSON for sharing or agents
Create jump links that open and focus a specific Canvas node
Apply font colors, transparent cards, and the Claude Canvas theme
extras: README warns it relies on Obsidian's internal Canvas runtime APIs, which may change between releases; the theme is local CSS only and does not modify .canvas data. Parts of the README are in Chinese.
intentEvidence: Canvas Authoring adds mind-map-style node creation, orthogonal links, font colors, duplication, clipboard tools, and a Claude Canvas theme.
problem: Obsidian Canvas lacks quick mind-map-style node creation, orthogonal connectors, per-node font colors, duplication, and group clipboard/JSON tools.
summary: Canvas authoring toolkit that adds mind-map-style node creation, orthogonal links, font colors, duplication, clipboard tools, and a Claude Canvas theme.
